name: track-switch-sampling
description: Sampled-mode behaviour of the input sampling switch at 1 MS/s with the real 8.83 pF CDAC array load: worst-case acquisition settling, charge injection / clock feedthrough vs ratiometric input level, and hold droop. T-gate at two sizes and dummy-compensated T-gate; the bootstrapped-switch branches (bs10/bs20) are disabled in the netlist per DR-0007 (bootstrap rejected; its internal feedback loop dominated simulation cost by >10x).
claim: README.md#target-specification -- gain error (<= 0.5 LSB), offset (<= 2 LSB), INL/DNL and SFDR contributions of the sampling switch, and the input-structure row's settling/droop numbers.
